messages:
ops-incident-bot: PAGE: INC-2029-0912 — High p99 latency on inference-prod (us-west). Current p99 ~1200ms, error rate slight uptick. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/inference-p99. Paging @sara (oncall) and @raj (sre).

sara (oncall): I'm on it — jumping into logs and traces now. ETA 5m. taking lead for handoff.

raj (sre): grabbing grafana and prometheus. initial glance: eviction spikes around 04:45 UTC. could be KV cache or batching fallout from recent rollout. @deploy-bot what rolled in us-west?

deploy-bot: Deploy event: model-serving v3.9.1 deployed to cluster inference-prod-us-west at 2029-09-12T04:44:30Z by ci/cd pipeline.

kevin (eng): saw similar pattern in the staging run earlier — KV cache evictions + higher mem pressure after that release. i'm scaling node pool + upping cache limiter to reduce evictions. applying a short maintenance window for autoscaler alerts.

kevin (eng): executing mitigation commands now:
```bash
# add 2 nodes to nodepool
kubectl scale --replicas=6 deployment/inference-worker -n prod-us-west
# temporary silence for autoscale noisy alerts
/ops silence alert "nodepool-autoscale-failure" --for 2h --reason "mitigation for evictions after v3.9.1"
```

sara (oncall): Applying silence for the high-latency alert so we don't wake up everyone while we stabilize. Doing 2h silence on alert group `high-latency-inference-prod`.

raj (sre): Added a short grafana panel for eviction_rate and kv_hit_rate: https://grafana.redwood/inference/evictions-us-west. also adding a synthetic ping to check tail latency every 30s.

marie (pm): Any visible customer impact? support reports a handful of 5xxs for a few tenants. are we throttling?

kevin (eng): customer-facing errors came from request timeouts as p99 spiked. scale started ~04:47, p99 dropped from ~1.2s to ~0.6s after nodes came up. will continue to monitor.

ops-incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigation in progress (scale + cache tuning). Continue monitoring for 15m. Please confirm if we move to "monitoring" phase or escalate.

sara (oncall): moving to monitoring. note: before we remove silences we should validate alert thresholds — the current p99 alert fires too sensitively around traffic bursts. proposing temp threshold change.

kevin (eng): propose this change (temporary):
```yaml
alert: HighP99InferenceLatency
expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="inference"}[5m])) by (le)) > 1.2
for: 5m
labels:
  severity: critical
annotations:
  summary: "p99 latency > 1.2s (prod)"
```
We raised to 1.2s from 0.8s for 24h while we validate.

raj (sre): I'd rather keep two levels: warning at 0.7s and critical at 1.2s. That gives oncall earlier heads-up but avoids noise. I'll prepare the rule update and a dashboard compare panel for the last 7d.

marie (pm): +1 to warning + critical. Also add a note to the incident summary that thresholds were temporarily adjusted and will be validated in postmortem. customers impacted list will be included.

sara (oncall): creating follow-up ticket: ALERTS-237 (Validate and rebaseline inference alerts after v3.9.1). Tasks: update dashboards (assign raj), runbook update (assign kevin), confirm silence windows and automation (sara). Due: 3 working days.

kevin (eng): ack. i'll also open a small RFC to tune batching defaults to reduce KV churn — should help long-term.

ops-incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: system stable for 30m, p99 steady ~0.55s, error rate back to baseline. Reminder: silences expire in 2h from creation; please remove early if we don't need them. Please file postmortem and close the incident when ready.

sara (oncall): thanks folks — adding postmortem draft here: https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-2029-0912/postmortem-draft. I'll own the follow-ups: ALERTS-237 + runbook edits. Will validate thresholds after 24h of monitoring with the new warning/critical split. :white_check_mark: :eyes:

raj (sre): I'll push the warning/critical alert rules and the dashboard diff to the alerts repo. ping me if you want a demo of synthetic checks. :thumbsup:

marie (pm): Great coordination — please include customer impact table in the postmortem and a timeline of the deploy + onset of evictions.

kevin (eng): quick note to ops: when removing the silence, let's switch autoscaler alerts back on but keep the warning channel limited to #eng-oncall for 48h to avoid noise.

sara (oncall): noted. closing live thread. follow-ups in ALERTS-237 and INC-2029-0912 PM. Good job team. :clap:
